project_type: Python 3.11 single-process modular app: Flask server-rendered web UI + CLI pipeline (Discover->Normalize->Deduplicate->Verify->Rank->Display) backed by SQLite. Not microservices.
build_system: uv (uv sync --extra dev) + Makefile. Deps in pyproject.toml + uv.lock. Add new deps with `uv add <pkg>` (updates both). uv.lock IS gitignored per .gitignore.
test_framework: pytest (testpaths=['tests'], addopts='-ra -q'). Offline, deterministic, fixture-backed; NO live network in any test.
test_command: make check  (runs: uv run ruff check . ; uv run black --check . ; uv run mypy ; uv run pytest). Individual: `uv run pytest tests/<file> -q`.
verification_instructions: Every new/changed module MUST pass ruff (select E,F,I,UP,B,W), black --check, mypy (strict=true, disallow_untyped_defs), and pytest. Run `make check` for the full gate. Baseline before this task: 93 tests pass, all green. For deployment: `uv run gunicorn vandy_food_radar.web.wsgi:app --bind 127.0.0.1:8000` after seeding, then curl the index and grep for 'Vandy Food Radar'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: store.db is generated by `python -m vandy_food_radar --db store.db seed` (or the web /seed and /refresh routes) and is gitignored (*.db). requirements-prod.txt is generated via `uv export --no-dev --no-hashes -o requirements-prod.txt` and SHOULD be committed for pip-based platforms.
environment_constraints: OFFLINE by default (Config.offline=True). No test may make a live network call: mock all Google API / maps HTTP clients. Do NOT commit credentials or store.db. mypy is strict, so untyped Google libraries need narrow `# type: ignore[import-untyped]` or stubs. Do not leave an APScheduler BackgroundScheduler thread running in tests (scheduler must be OFF by default). git remote origin = jingyu-ruan/vandy-food-radar; branch is 'master'. Commit locally, never push.
contribution_requirements: Reuse existing interfaces verbatim; do NOT rewrite them. All new config flags default OFF/offline. App boots and serves with NO Google creds set (offline/demo mode showing seeded fixtures). Never auto-add events to calendar (FR-40) — only an explicitly selected event. Unknown walking must use the neutral ranking value, never zero (FR-30, AC-8), exactly as M6 does.
key_patterns: Providers are Protocols with concrete impls + a build_*_provider(config) selector (providers/location.py, providers/calendar.py). Config is nested @dataclass with defaults; Config.from_env layers VFR_-prefixed env overrides using _parse_bool/_parse_enum/_parse_float helpers, falling back to defaults on bad input. Pipeline run(window,*,repository,sources,location_provider,config)->RunReport; idempotent upsert keyed on Event.identity_key via SqliteRepository.save_event + find_by_identity_key; history via _diff_history over _TRACKED_FIELDS. CLI (cli.py) builds sources via build_sources(config, default_fetcher(config)) and Window.from_config(config, today=...). Web create_app(config,*,repository,sources=None,location_provider=None,today_provider=None) injects collaborators; reads ONLY through Repository; templates in web/templates/{index.html,_event_card.html}. Tests use SqliteRepository(':memory:'), seed_demo(...today=FIXED_TODAY), and a _SingleRecordAdapter pattern for change-detection (see tests/test_pipeline_e2e.py).
